issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled with a TODO instead of executing the Union/Optional modernization the PR advertises.
issues.detail: The PR description claims Union and Optional should become 'A | B' / 'A | None', but ruff.toml silences the three rules that enforce it with a TODO ('it's a lot of errors'). Either land the codemod in this series or drop the claim. Shipping the intent without the proof is misleading.

issues.description: default_raise shim and < 3.10 comments remain in wallet_request_types after the precondition is gone.
issues.detail: default_raise() exists explicitly 'for < 3.10 compatibility' and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still cites the < 3.10 workaround. With 3.10 as the floor and real kw_only, field(default_factory=default_raise) should become a plain required kw_only field. Leaving the scaffolding misleads the next maintainer.

issues.description: install.sh version guard still permits Python 3.7-3.9 while the error string and pyproject claim >= 3.10.
issues.detail: The guard reads PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7, but the message now says '>= 3.10' and pyproject requires 3.10+. A 3.8 interpreter passes the check and prints a contradictory message. Tighten the literal to 10 so the predicate matches the stated minimum.

issues.description: Noisy 'dnf search python3.12' added to install-scripts CI prep with no assertion.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep runs dnf search before installing. Search is diagnostic noise: failure is ignored, success is unused, and it slows CI. Either drop the line or convert it into a fail-fast precondition check before dnf install.

issues.description: kw_only_dataclass helper deleted but @dataclass_transform marker lost at call sites.
issues.detail: Replacing kw_only_dataclass with bare @dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True) is runtime-equivalent but loses the explicit @dataclass_transform(frozen_default=True, kw_only_default=True) marker that tools and type-checkers used. Verify mypy/pyright still infers kw_only across all sites, or restore a single named transform.

issues.description: Unrelated itertools.pairwise refactor mixed into the mechanical 3.9 removal.
issues.detail: The zip(ordered, ordered[1:]) -> itertools.pairwise change in test_priority_mutex.py is enabled by 3.10 but is a separate logical cleanup. A diff that does two things should be two diffs; split it so the version-drop patch stays purely mechanical.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the mechanical removal of Python 3.9 support is correctly shaped where it actually deletes version forks (cmd_classes.py is exemplary), but the PR ships the discipline only half-applied. The stated typing modernization (Union/Optional to '|') is silenced in ruff.toml with a TODO, the default_raise shim and < 3.10 comments remain as dead scaffolding in wallet_request_types.py, and install.sh's guard still accepts 3.7-3.9 despite advertising 3.10+. Finish the ruff conversion (or land it as the next patch in the series), strip the stale compatibility shims, align the install.sh predicate, and drop the noisy dnf search from CI.
